title: Mobile account isolation: session-scoped query cache, guarded token writes and late exports

acceptance_criteria.outcome: The mobile app uses one QueryClient per signed-in session, replaced on explicit and forced (401) sign-out; a mutation in flight at sign-out cannot write old data into the next account's cache, and CoreApp mounts the provider.

Password-change and token-refresh token writes happen only if the sign-in session that started the request is still current (same user signing out and back in is a new session; a normal refresh is not), and a sign-out between the check and the two writes leaves no tokens.
Account export, full-data download, group export and group invite share drop a result that arrives after the session changed, without opening the share sheet.

A native account-switch E2E flow covers cached data across accounts, other module-level or persisted user-data caches are reviewed, SecureStore keys are unchanged, and a forced sign-out still skips sign-out cleanups.

The web app uses one QueryClient per signed-in account, replaced on logout, forced logout and an account switch, so a late save or the next login never sees the previous account's cache, and App mounts it.

AI consent is stored per account (granted:<email>): after a forced sign-out the next account is asked, a prompt left open by the previous account cannot consent the next, and an older bare consent is asked again.
Registering an Expo push token removes other accounts' rows for the same token, so a device signed out without a clean unregister stops receiving the previous account's notifications.

implementation_approval.reference: User messages 2026-11-25: 'Go with this' (original three fixes, base branch mobile-app-analytics, changes uncommitted, no push, template untouched) and, after the review report listing the web QueryClient P1, the AI-consent P2 and the push-registration P2: 'Fix those P1 and P2 findings'. Design choices for those three fixes are recorded in requirements.md and are open to review. Plan text was later extended (implementation.md) with review-driven hardening of the same fixes (token validation and a rate limit on /devices/register, web subtree remount); the fingerprint was re-recorded for that text under the same instruction and is disclosed to the owner for confirmation.

notes: Built on branch mobile-app-analytics together with TS-GA4-002 (owner decision 2026-11-25); changes uncommitted, no push. Template (cerebroos-mobile-app-template) is not edited; the core files it should take back are listed at the end of Build. Scope widened 2026-11-25 by owner instruction to fix review findings S-1 (web cache), S-2 (AI consent) and S-3 (push registration).
